reason: Make raw blocker evidence authoritative and supersession mutations retryable after every interruption boundary.
changes: When raw blocking_failures are present, their list length is authoritative over any redundant top-level blocker count.
Predecessors receive a superseded_by identity before their immutable superseded_at timestamp.
Protection accepts a predecessor already linked to the same successor as the same logical retry, but rejects every other inactive predecessor.
Retries preserve an existing supersession timestamp and converge the current owner decision without extending the grace period.
Publication initializes superseded_by explicitly, and retention requires superseded_by/superseded_at to be both absent or both present.
A partial supersession link globally blocks deletion until the protection retry converges.
